retrieved_synopses: Loomp is an unusually sharp ogre in the goblin boss’s pay who inspects people for the brand of the Absolute — if you lack the mark he immediately sizes you up as either meat or a source of coin. Off‑screen he and any ogre companions are sustained by goblin rewards: gold and the promise of slaughter, so Loomp values plunder and a good meal above gods. The player can bluff (claim to be a chosen disciple), bribe, or otherwise persuade him; his tone flips between ironic, educated observations and brutish, hungry threats as he tests you. If suitably convinced or paid, Loomp can be recruited to fight alongside you, and he may bring his fellows with him.

Three ogres are mid‑feast, arguing over what the corpse they're gnawing on tastes like, when they notice the player and demand proof they aren't a meal. Two of the ogres are brutish and dim, while Lump — who accidentally ate a headband of intellect — speaks with an unnaturally deep, slick voice and treats food (and people) with lascivious, calculating relish. Off‑screen the ogres work for goblins who pay them in coin and expect them to check brands and affiliations, so Lump asks about the "brand of the Absolute" to decide whether someone is friend or food. Lump openly mocks religion and follows only gluttony and greed, so bluffing as a disciple can sometimes buy time but may still fail to save you.

context: Background: Loomp (called "Lump the Enlightened" in some lines) is an unusually sharp, food‑obsessed ogre in the goblin boss’s pay who inspects newcomers for the brand of the Absolute. Off‑screen he and any ogre companions are kept happy with goblin coin and the promise of slaughter, so Loomp sizes unmarked people up as either meat or a source of plunder. He shifts between slick, educated observations and brutish, hungry threats—especially when talking down to his dimmer brothers mid‑feast—because he values gluttony and greed over gods. The player can bluff (claim to be a disciple), bribe, or otherwise persuade him; if convinced, Loomp may join the player in battle and bring his fellows.
